peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 6.1% below its local comparables; 54 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (36.0): 2.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 137 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 9). Initial resale-wave effect: 2 of the 10 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Feb 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 29.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,438,888 ($1,922 psf, 1,259–1,280 sq ft; 5 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,047 psf (range $1,546–2,299); 6.1% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $159,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 2.5 resales per 100 homes a year over 19 months (Mar 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 137 of 379 similar developments. First resale wave from Mar 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 4 earlier resales do not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 2.5.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Toa Payoh MRT about 470 m, Novena MRT about 970 m; closer than 367 of 662 similar developments (the same as 15). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 11 within 2 km; nearest CHIJ Primary (Toa Payoh) about 950 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 340 m), more than 281 of 662 similar developments (the same as 80); nearest hawker centre Toa Payoh Vista Market about 750 m; nearest park Toa Payoh Town Park about 160 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Orie, 25 new sales, about 1,260 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,620 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,660 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,720 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,990 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 272 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 77 new sales and 765 resales (842 purchases); new sales were 9.1% of these purchases. Subsales (44) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 610 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,580 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 765 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 329 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 765 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 810 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−5.6%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
